claims.evidence: Organism NEWT:9606; recombinant human APP751; human UniProt database

Protocol text and RAW header string 'Q Exactive HF-X - Orbitrap MS'; PRIDE dropdown says Q Exactive HF (overridden)
in-solution trypsin digestion overnight; mzid Enzyme Trypsin, 2 missed cleavages; no second protease reported
Coupled APP reduced with dithiothreitol and alkylated with iodoacetamide
